There is hereby created the Philippine Strategic Oil, Gas,
Energy Resources and Power Infrastructure Office (PSOGERPIO)
Office of the President and which shall hold office at the Department of Energy.
It shall primarily promote, assist and fast-track crucial private'sector-led
energy resources, power and other energy projects to avert the fast approaching
energy crisis. The Office shall be headed by a Presidential Assistant.

The PSOGERPIO, herein known as the "Office", shall:
Develop the Five-Year Philippine Energy Crisis Strategic Plan (PECSP
20Q6-2010) which shall outline the plans, projects and strategies in
averting any approaching energy crisis. The PECSP shall be updated
annually by the Office;
